text:
maria_cs: pinging the team — CypressHealth is asking to onboard a custom 13B medical-summarizer into Private (VPC). They flagged PHI, HSM requirement, and want safety/ hallucination evals before renewal next month. Can we triage?

oliver_se: noted. do we have model artifact / HF link from them yet?

cypress_eng: hey y'all — sent s3 link in DM earlier: s3://cypress-uploads/models/ch-med-13b-v1.tar.gz. training data includes de-identified records and some tagged PHI. we need an HSM flow for key wrapping.

maria_cs: customer is requesting on-prem style controls (HSM + audit logs), and needs our eval suite run on their prompt set (see attached set) + hallucination/precision checks. renewal conversation in 3 weeks, so timeline is tight.

tina_security: from security side we need: sample of training provenance, data retention policy, KMS/HSM integration spec, and a small verification eval (10-20 prompts) that includes PHI edge-cases. also will need a PDP for network egress.

sam_product: for the Dedicated/Private runtime: expected qps and p95 latency SLO? that will drive whether 13B quantized 4-bit is ok or we need 8-bit or multi-GPU.

cypress_eng: target is ~8 qps with 95th < 300ms on 256-token responses. can try q4_0 but accuracy must be preserved.

oliver_se: got it. next steps: 1) security to confirm list of docs we need, 2) infra to estimate cost/instance type, 3) eval team to run hallucination/regression tests on their prompt set. i'll coordinate.

maria_cs: customer is worried about renewal if we can't meet HSM + privacy controls. flagged as a medium-high renewal risk.

tina_security: uploading checklist to the ticket. quick checklist snippet:

```
- training_provenance.csv
- data_retention_policy.pdf
- KMS_integration_spec (HSM vendor, key rotation)
- test_prompts/patient_edgecases.csv
- SLA_requirements doc
```

oliver_se: infra estimate: for q4_0 13B in Private VPC, we recommend 1x A10G or 1x H100 with memory-optimized instance; if they want 8 qps p95<300ms probably 1x H100 with bf16/quant fallback. i'll confirm costs tomorrow.

sam_product: eval harness — can infra provide ephemeral dedicated node for evals with telemetry exported to Console? we need token-level traces and divergence metrics.

oliver_se: yes, we can spin a short-lived node and collect traces. need customer sign-off for data capture during evals.

maria_cs: I'll ask them to sign the eval data capture NDA today.

cypress_eng: can we get a template for the eval requests? also want to include safety thresholds: hallucination rate < 2% on curated set, PHI leakage = 0.

tina_security: accepted thresholds noted. PHI leakage = 0 means zero tolerance; we'll define exact detection heuristics.

oliver_se: i'll open an internal runbook task and assign to @eng-runtime for provisioning and @eval-team for scoring.

maria_cs: thanks — i've told the customer: "we'll start the security checklist and a short eval within 5 business days; provisioning ETA 3 days after docs." i'll update the renewal owner.

deploy-bot: Provisioning request created: PR-4532 for ephemeral eval node. ETA 48h.

maria_cs: ack. tagging this as high-priority for renewal. will follow up daily until docs received. :thumbsup:
